summary: Frontend-only verification of two recent bug fixes: (1) Europe page layout (/destination/Europe) and (2) Bhutan image on homepage TrendingDestinations. Both fixes verified working end-to-end via Playwright.
passed_highlights: Homepage Bhutan image loads correctly (naturalWidth=800, complete=true, URL = https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593331792312-15bead7aaa9b?w=800&q=80). No more broken image.
All 6 trending destination cards (Egypt, Japan, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Bhutan, Kazakhstan) render images successfully (all naturalWidth > 0).
Europe card at bottom of TrendingDestinations links correctly to /destination/Europe and renders Notre Dame Unsplash image (200 OK).

Europe page renders all 6 sections in the correct vertical order: (1) Hero 'Your DMC to Europe' with inquiry form (y=608), (2) 'Our services for Europe' with 6 service cards FIT/Group Tours/MICE/Ad Hoc Groups/Experiences/Transfers & Logistics (y=956), (3) Stats bar incl. '2,400+ Packages' and '20+ COUNTRIES' (in hero badge), (4) 'Browse by region' with 4 working tabs Western/Central/Southern/Northern Europe (y=1691), (5) 'Sell Europe by theme' 4 cards: Honeymoons & Romance, Northern Lights & Arctic, Culinary Trails, Alpine & Adventure (y=2116), (6) 'Custom packages we create' 6 cards (Paris-Swiss-Italy, London-Scotland, Scandinavia, Spain-Portugal, Central European Classic, Mediterranean Honeymoon) (y=2736), (7) 'Europe experiences' 8 cards (Seine Cruise, Gondola, Northern Lights, Swiss Train, Flamenco, Blue Lagoon, Prague Castle, Tuscan Cooking) (y=3311).
All 4 region tabs (Western/Central/Southern/Northern) clickable and switchable; Western shows France, Italy, Spain, United Kingdom country pills.
Europe page has zero broken images (15/15 images loaded successfully).

Hero inquiry form contains all required fields: Agency/Company Name, Contact Person Name, Phone country-code dropdown (IN +91 default), Phone number, Email, State (India states cascade populated: Andhra Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Delhi, Goa, Gujarat...).
Inquiry form submission works: POST /api/inquiries returned 200 OK, page shows 'Thank You! Our Europe team will contact you within 24 hours.' + toast 'Inquiry submitted!'.
critical_code_review_comments: Europe inquiry form inputs lack data-testid attributes (only placeholder selectors available). Recommend adding data-testid="europe-form-agency", -contact, -phone, -email, -state, -submit for test robustness.

Trending Destinations Europe card uses a hardcoded EUROPE_IMG constant in TrendingDestinations.js (line 9) rather than fetching from /api/destinations — diverges from the data-driven pattern used for the other 6 cards. Acceptable since Europe is treated as a region aggregate, but worth a comment.

City field was not visible in the hero form during testing. The PRD mentions State/City cascade for India — only the State dropdown is currently rendered (City may appear on subsequent flow or after State selection but did not surface during test). Confirm City field expectation with main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Europe layout rebuild and Bhutan image fix are fully verified. Bhutan now uses https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1593331792312-15bead7aaa9b?w=800&q=80 in both MongoDB seed (server.py SEED_DESTINATIONS) and code (seed_data_new.py _BT). EuropePage.js renders 6 sections in correct order. Hero inquiry form submits successfully to POST /api/inquiries (200). Only minor non-blocking finding: hero form lacks data-testid attributes — added as code-review note. No City field surfaced in hero form; only State dropdown — main agent to confirm whether City is expected here.
rca_of_the_issue: Original Bhutan bug RCA (resolved): _BT dictionary in seed_data_new.py and SEED_DESTINATIONS in server.py contained invalid Unsplash photo IDs that returned 404. Replaced with valid photo-1593331792312-15bead7aaa9b (Tiger's Nest monastery). Both static code and MongoDB document updated. Verified via direct HEAD request (200) and in-browser naturalWidth>0.
